get_script_predictor: get a script predictor function that identifies the writing script of a given text string
predict_script_text: predict the writing script of a text string and return the script name with a confidence score
get_script_map: load a language to script mapping from a tab-separated file into a dictionary
find_lang_script: find the expected writing script for a specific language code from a mapping file
test_predict_script: run the test suite to verify the script predictor correctly identifies Latin, Bengali, Thai, and Korean scripts
